topic: Java application security and upgrade planning
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the potential vulnerability of Java applications, specifically regarding Log4j. It was confirmed that while a mobile API uses an older version (1.2.17) that predates the specific vulnerability, there is concern about public-facing components. Regarding development work, [me] stated plans to create a full copy of the main system in a dev environment and suggested provisioning four servers for this setup, noting that this task is not urgent.
decisions: The mobile API uses an older version of Log4j (1.2.17) which mitigates the immediate vulnerability concern.
